content.text: The Cardinals go for their fourth straight win on Sunday afternoon when they visit the Astros The St. Louis Cardinals look to clinch a series sweep of the Houston Astros on Sunday afternoon. The Cardinals have taken the first two games of the series against the Astros and have now won four games in a row. The winning streak has pushed their record to 12-8 on the season. On Sunday, the Cardinals will send Matthew Liberatore to the mound. Liberatore comes into the game 0-1 with a 4.29 ERA on the season. The Cardinals lost his last start, but had won his first three. Despite those three wins, Liberatore didn’t record a win in any of them. In his last outing, he went five innings against the Cleveland Guardians. He gave up four runs on six hits in the loss.
